channel.title: Svelte on Jakob Richter
channel.description: Recent content in Svelte on Jakob Richter

item.title: games.jakob-r.de
item.description: A small collection of minimalistic multiplayer browser games such as Sudoku, Käsekästchen and Minesweeper, played together in real time via a shared link. No registration, no ads and no tracking. The code is available on GitHub.

item.title: tools.jakob-r.de
item.description: Small helpers that run entirely in the browser, e.g. a Markdown/HTML converter, a Base64 encoder and a GPX track cleaner. Your text and files never leave the page. The code is available on GitHub.

item.title: playground.jakob-r.de
item.description: A loose collection of small web toys that explain something or are just nice to watch, such as the Fourier Lens, which shows how JPEG-style compression keeps an image while cutting away frequencies.
